results.title: Niple
results.overview: Insecure Danny is trying to reinvent himself as a trendsetting nonconformist—but his plans are derailed by a grotesquely swollen, leaking nipple he refuses to have medically treated. As job interviews implode, dates curdle, and strangers recoil, Danny clings to the idea that his “condition” is just another sign he’s ahead of the curve.

results.title: Hollow Trees
results.overview: Years after a devastating war, a hardened survivor and a young boy are forced from their home by a creature capable of imitating humans. As they journey north in search of refuge, their fragile bond is pushed to its limits.

results.title: Caught by Love
results.overview: While on a journey of self-discovery, a resort guest gets swept into an undercover investigation for stolen jewels that turns into an unexpected and adventurous romance.

results.title: Sweety Naughty Crazy
results.overview: Shiva, a charming college student juggling three different relationships. As he tries to keep them secret, love, lust, and chaos collide in a playful mix of adult humor, romance, and comedy.

results.title: The Worm
results.overview: A young man’s strange belief sparks an intervention from his family.

results.title: Breeder
results.overview: A woman on the fence about having kids is hunted in her home by a demonic horse-man from Filipino folklore.

results.title: Wyatt Earp
results.overview: When Wyatt Earp arrives in Dead River, Texas, hoping to purchase the ghost town, he meets a lonely barkeep who asks for his help in ridding the town of ruthless outlaws.  In return, Wyatt is offered the keys to the city.

results.title: Time of Death
results.overview: When a prisoner vanishes without a trace, Detective Frank Morley (Michael Kelly) is sent to a decaying prison on the verge of shutdown. What begins as a routine investigation quickly spirals into a dangerous search for answers.

results.title: Relatives
results.overview: After many years of actively avoiding her family, Mariia finally decides to pay them a visit, seemingly to celebrate her grandmother's jubilee. However, her intentions might not be as wholesome as it seems, as the true nature of her visit lies in the fact that the birthday girl decided to grant Mariia the ownership over her home. Mariia's uncle Grygorii learns of this and decides to engage in a turf war with his niece, hoping that this will result in the latter changing her mind. However, the young entrepeneur is a tougher nut to crack than it initially looks.

results.title: The Draft!
results.overview: 5 student. An old villa. Old well. Forbidden room. Dark secret of the past. A seemingly omnipotent evil. Survival is the key. Let the battle of wits begins...

results.title: Redemption River
results.overview: Stranded after a rafting accident, a couple on the brink of collapse must come together to escape the unforgiving wilderness.

results.title: One Hour Girlfriend
results.overview: A reclusive man hires a woman for a one-hour companion visit, treating intimacy as a controlled experiment. As the hour unfolds, emotional barriers erode, forcing him to confront love, time, and loss

results.title: Mama
results.overview: After many years working far from home, Mila is forced to temporarily leave her seaside mansion—and her secret romance—to return to her family in a remote Polish village. But the long-awaited reunion is far from what she imagined.  As tensions surface, Mila struggles to repair what was lost, confronting the cost of her choices and the woman she has become.

results.title: Teenieping: Legend of the Whale Heartstone
results.overview: Romi has been living happily ever since Heartsping became her best friend. But she and her mother, Belita, keep clashing over what Romi wants to do versus what she's told she must do... Then one day, an event that shakes the entire sea sweeps her mother away without a trace. Romi loses her mother without ever getting to say sorry — without one last hug. Standing before the sea for the very first time, she finds the courage to act, together with her best friend Heartsping, the sea boy Kite, and three Teeniepings... Together, they must face a dazzling underwater city and colossal creatures of the deep. And at last, Romi comes face to face with a secret her mother had never once told her.

results.title: If I Were Alive
results.overview: Gilberto and Jacira promised to grow old together – for better, for worse, for richer, for poorer, in sickness and in health. Till death them do part.

results.title: Space Cadet
results.overview: A young astronaut and her guardian robot explore grief, loss and love across generations.

results.title: The Man from Carrickfergus
results.overview: Northern Ireland, 1972. IRA enforcer Josie Connors is assigned to execute Richie McGavin, a suspected traitor. But when the killing is delayed, she develops a growing connection to her unaware captive, testing her loyalty and commitment to her role.  Inspired by true events.

results.title: Half
results.overview: A mixed Japanese and Caucasian woman reflects on identity, belonging and the responsibilities and biases that accompany her background.

results.title: Jurassic Rampage
results.overview: Dinosaurs transported by armored truck escape into a nearby neighborhood. A family trapped there must survive the deadly onslaught.
